chapters.reason: The paper explicitly introduces Diffusion-LM, which maps discrete tokens to continuous embeddings and iteratively denoises them, fitting the definition of embedding-based diffusion.
The paper focuses on controllable text generation, demonstrating the model's capability to perform complex, fine-grained control tasks through gradient-based optimization.
The model's iterative denoising process involves a trajectory of latent variables that can be interpreted as a form of information flow refinement across the diffusion steps.
